What We Build

Screen Enclosure Services in Central Florida

From a brand-new pool cage to a single torn screen panel — we handle the full range of screen enclosure work, and we pull every required permit so you don't have to.

🏊 01

Pool & Lanai Enclosures

A pool enclosure does more than keep out mosquitoes — it extends your swim season, reduces chemical use, and protects your investment. We build aluminum-framed birdcage and hip-roof enclosures designed for Florida's wind load requirements, using 18×16 no-see-um screen or heavier Super Screen where privacy matters. Every enclosure is permitted and inspected.

Get a Free Estimate
🌿 02

Screen Rooms

A screen room transforms an underused patio or concrete slab into a year-round outdoor living area. We frame in aluminum, screen it floor to ceiling, and can add a roof system to keep it dry. Choose from standard screen, privacy screen, or solar screen depending on your sun exposure and preference.

Get a Free Estimate
🏡 03

Porch & Patio Enclosures

If you have a covered porch or lanai slab, enclosing it is one of the fastest ways to add usable square footage to your home. We tie into your existing roofline, frame in aluminum columns and screen panels, and handle the permit so you don't have to.

Get a Free Estimate
🔧 04

Rescreening & Repairs

Florida's weather is hard on screen. UV degradation, flying debris, and curious pets all take a toll. We replace screen in individual panels or rescreen entire enclosures, and we stock the same gauge and mesh pattern your existing structure uses so repairs blend seamlessly.

Get a Free Estimate
☀️ 05

Sunroom Conversions

Already have a screen enclosure and want more? We can convert it into a 3-season or 4-season sunroom by adding acrylic or glass panels, insulated roof panels, and optional mini-split HVAC. The result is a fully conditioned bonus room that adds real value to your home.

Get a Free Estimate
🌀 06

Hurricane Screen Systems

Florida homeowners increasingly choose motorized roll-down hurricane screens as an alternative to plywood or accordion shutters. They protect enclosure openings, lanai areas, and windows — and when not in use, they roll away cleanly. We install systems that meet Florida Product Approval requirements.

Get a Free Estimate

Not sure which service you need?

That's completely normal — screen enclosures can get complicated. Give us a call, describe your situation, and we'll tell you exactly what makes sense and what it'll cost.
